plugins.name: debrief
plugins.description: An end-of-session learning ritual that converts finished work into durable understanding — by making you recall and reconstruct it before filling any gaps, instead of letting the AI's fluency stand in for your own.

plugins.name: product-view
plugins.description: A conversational lens that keeps Claude in product-space — describing what the human on the other side of the screen experiences — until you explicitly ask to cross into code-space.
